# Expense Reimbursement Policy

## 1. Principles
Spend company money as if it were your own. Expenses must be business-related, reasonable, approved and supported by valid receipts.

## 2. How to claim
1. Submit claims in **SpendWise** (spendwise.orbitra.internal or the mobile app — snap a photo of the receipt).
2. **Submit within 30 days** of the expense date. Claims older than **60 days** are rejected automatically unless approved by the Financial Controller.

5. **Payment:** Claims fully approved by the **20th** are paid with that month's salary. Claims approved after the 20th are paid in the next month's salary. US/UK: paid by bank transfer in the next weekly run (every Friday).

results.question: What is the gift limit from a vendor?
results.answer:
The gift limit from a vendor is **INR 5,000 / USD 75 / GBP 60 per person per year**【HR-COC-001】.

- Cash or cash‑equivalent gifts (gift cards, vouchers) are never allowed.  
- Any gift exceeding the limit must be entered in the Gift Register (PeopleHub → Declarations) within 7 days and may need to be returned.  
- Gifts to government officials (including state‑owned enterprises) require prior written Legal approval【LEG-002】.

chunks.text:
## 3. Outside employment (moonlighting)
- Paid work for another organisation, including freelancing, is **not permitted** without written approval from your HRBP and department head.
- Unpaid open-source contributions, teaching, writing and non-profit work are allowed **outside working hours**, provided they do not use Orbitra confidential information or compete with Orbitra. Contributions to open-source projects that relate to Orbitra's products require approval from the Open Source Program Office (ospo@orbitra.io).

## 4. Gifts and hospitality
- Gifts **to or from** customers, vendors or partners must not exceed **INR 5,000 / USD 75 / GBP 60** per person per year.
- Cash or cash equivalents (gift cards, vouchers) are never allowed.
- Anything above the limit must be declared in the **Gift Register** (PeopleHub → Declarations) within 7 days and may need to be returned.
- No gifts to government officials without Legal approval (see LEG-002 Anti-Bribery).

## Part B – Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption (ABAC)
Orbitra complies with the Prevention of Corruption Act (India), the US FCPA and the UK Bribery Act 2010.
- Never offer, give, request or accept anything of value to improperly influence a business decision.
- **Facilitation payments** ("speed money") are prohibited, even if small or customary.
- **Government officials** (including employees of state-owned enterprises): no gifts, meals or hospitality without prior written approval from Legal.
- Third-party agents and resellers must undergo ABAC due diligence before onboarding.
- Gifts and hospitality limits are in HR-COC-001 §4.
- Report concerns to ethics@orbitra.io or the Ethics Hotline (LEG-003).

results.question: I joined on 1 September 2026 and I'm on probation. Can I take 8 days of EL in December?
results.answer:
No – while on probation you can use at most 6 days of Earned Leave, so 8 days in December isn’t allowed.  

- Probation limits EL usage to 6 days total during the first 6 months [HR-LV-001].  
- EL accrues 1.5 days on the 1st of each month; by December you’ll have 6 days credited [HR-LV-001].  
- Any EL request must be applied in PeopleHub → Leave → Apply Leave and approved by your manager [HR-LV-001].

chunks.text:
"Immediate family" means spouse, child, parent, sibling, parent-in-law. "Extended family" means grandparent, grandchild, aunt, uncle, cousin.

## 3. Applying for leave
1. Apply in **PeopleHub → Leave → Apply Leave**. Your manager is the approver.
2. Planned leave of **more than 3 consecutive working days** must be applied at least **7 calendar days in advance**.
3. Sick leave of more than **2 consecutive days** requires a medical certificate uploaded in PeopleHub within 3 days of returning.
4. Leave not approved or rejected by the manager within 3 working days is **auto-approved**.
5. Weekends and public holidays falling between leave days are **not** counted as leave (sandwich rule does not apply at Orbitra).
6. Half-day leave is allowed for EL, SL and CL.

## 4. Probation
Employees on probation (first 6 months) accrue EL normally but may use a maximum of **6 days of EL** during probation. SL and CL are available pro-rated.

## 7. Leave encashment at exit
At exit, up to 30 days of EL balance is encashed at Basic salary / 30 per day as part of the Full and Final settlement (see HR-EXIT-001). SL, CL and comp-off are not encashed.

## 8. Holidays
India offices follow the published holiday calendar (HR-HOL-2026): 10 fixed holidays + 2 floating (optional) holidays.

## 9. FAQs
**Can I take EL in advance?** No. Only credited EL can be used.
**What if I fall sick during EL?** You can request your manager to convert EL days to SL with a medical certificate.
**Do I lose CL at year end?** Yes, CL and SL lapse on 31 December.
**Where do I check my balance?** PeopleHub → Leave → My Balances. If it looks wrong, raise OrbitDesk → HR → "Leave balance correction".

chunks.title: Accounts, Passwords, MFA and Application Access
chunks.text:
# Accounts, Passwords, MFA and Access

## 1. Single sign-on (Okta)
All company applications are accessed through **orbitra.okta.com**. Your username is your email address.

## 2. Password rules
- Minimum **14 characters**; must not contain your name or "orbitra".
- Passwords expire every **180 days**; you receive reminders 14, 7 and 1 day before expiry.
- Last 10 passwords cannot be reused.
- **Self-service reset:** orbitra.okta.com → "Forgot password?" → verify with Okta Verify or SMS. Takes 2 minutes.
- On Mac, after a reset, the laptop login password syncs on next login while connected to the internet (Okta Platform SSO). If it doesn't sync, connect to the office Wi-Fi or VPN and lock/unlock the screen.

## 3. Account lockout
After **5 failed attempts** your account is locked for **30 minutes** and then unlocks automatically. To unlock immediately, use self-service unlock at orbitra.okta.com or call Ext. 4000.

results.question: How do I report sexual harassment and how long do I have?
results.answer:
File a written complaint to **icc@orbitra.io** (US/UK employees may also contact their HRBP) within **3 months** of the incident — the period can be extended by another 3 months for valid reasons. [HR-POSH-001]

- Must be in writing.  
- Deadline is 3 months (extendable by 3 months for valid reasons).  
- If you cannot file, a friend, relative or colleague may file with your consent.  
- You may also request interim relief (transfer, leave up to 3 months, or restraint on the respondent).  
- The process is confidential.

chunks.text:
# POSH Policy

## 1. Scope
Applies to all Orbitra workplaces including offices, client sites, offsites, business travel, company events, virtual meetings, Slack and any work-related communication, regardless of time or place.

## 2. What constitutes sexual harassment
Unwelcome physical contact or advances; demand or request for sexual favours; sexually coloured remarks or jokes; showing pornography; any other unwelcome physical, verbal or non-verbal conduct of a sexual nature, including online.

## 3. Internal Committee (IC)
| Role | Name |
|---|---|
| Presiding Officer | Meera Iyer (CHRO) |
| Member | Shreya Gupta (HRBP) |
| Member | Aditya Banerjee (General Counsel) |
| Member | Neha Joshi (VP Engineering) |
| External member | Adv. Sunita Rao (NGO: SafeSpaces Foundation) |

Contact: **icc@orbitra.io** (read only by IC members). US and UK employees may also contact their HRBP.

chunks.title: Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Policy
chunks.text:
Contact: **icc@orbitra.io** (read only by IC members). US and UK employees may also contact their HRBP.

## 4. Filing a complaint
- File in writing to icc@orbitra.io within **3 months** of the incident (extendable by another 3 months for valid reasons).
- If the complainant cannot file, a friend, relative or colleague may file with their consent.
- Interim relief (transfer, leave up to 3 months, restraint on the respondent) can be requested.

## 5. Inquiry process
1. IC acknowledges within **2 working days**.
2. Conciliation may be attempted only if the complainant requests it (no monetary settlement).
3. Inquiry is completed within **90 days**; report within 10 days after.
4. Action recommended within 60 days of the report.

## 6. Confidentiality and non-retaliation
Identities, statements and outcomes are strictly confidential. Retaliation against complainants or witnesses is itself misconduct.

# Reporting Security Incidents and Phishing

## 1. What to report
- Suspicious emails, SMS, WhatsApp or calls (phishing, vishing, "CEO asking for gift cards").
- Clicking a suspicious link or entering your password on a suspicious page.
- Malware alerts, unexpected pop-ups, unknown software installed.
- Lost or stolen laptop, phone, or YubiKey (also see IT-002).
- Data sent to the wrong recipient, or customer data exposed.
- Unauthorised person in the office.

chunks.title: Reporting Security Incidents and Phishing
chunks.text:
You will **never** be penalised for reporting in good faith, even if you made the mistake.

## 3. How to spot phishing
- Sender domain looks similar but wrong (orbitra-hr.com, 0rbitra.io). Only **@orbitra.io** is ours.
- Urgency or secrecy: "do this now, don't tell anyone".
- Requests for gift cards, wire transfers, bank detail changes, or OTPs.
- Unexpected attachments (.html, .zip, .iso) or QR codes.
- Executives will **never** ask you to buy gift cards or share OTPs over WhatsApp.

## 4. Vendor bank detail change requests
Any email asking to change a vendor's bank account must be verified by **calling the vendor on a known number** (not the number in the email). Finance must follow FIN-003 §6.

## 5. What happens after you report
Security triages within 30 minutes (24x7). You may be asked to hand over your laptop for forensic analysis; a loaner will be provided.

## 3. Outside employment (moonlighting)
- Paid work for another organisation, including freelancing, is **not permitted** without written approval from your HRBP and department head.
- Unpaid open-source contributions, teaching, writing and non-profit work are allowed **outside working hours**, provided they do not use Orbitra confidential information or compete with Orbitra. Contributions to open-source projects that relate to Orbitra's products require approval from the Open Source Program Office (ospo@orbitra.io).

## 4. Gifts and hospitality
- Gifts **to or from** customers, vendors or partners must not exceed **INR 5,000 / USD 75 / GBP 60** per person per year.

chunks.title: Data Privacy (GDPR, DPDP Act) and Anti-Bribery & Anti-Corruption
chunks.text:
## Part B – Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption (ABAC)
Orbitra complies with the Prevention of Corruption Act (India), the US FCPA and the UK Bribery Act 2010.
- Never offer, give, request or accept anything of value to improperly influence a business decision.
- **Facilitation payments** ("speed money") are prohibited, even if small or customary.

|---|---|

Spend company money as if it were your own. Expenses must be business-related, reasonable, approved and supported by valid receipts.

results.question: I'm leaving Orbitra after 3 years. What happens to my ESOPs and gratuity?
results.answer:
**ESOPs:** You keep the options that have already vested (about 75% after 3 years) and can exercise them any time within 5 years of your leaving date; the unvested portion lapses on your last working day.

results.question: Can I deploy a non-urgent feature to production on 9 November 2026?
results.answer:
No – a non‑urgent production deployment is not allowed on 9 Nov 2026.

- 9 Nov falls within the Diwali freeze (6 Nov – 10 Nov 2026); only SEV1/SEV2 fixes are permitted and must have VP Engineering approval【ENG-004】.  
- It is also a public holiday for Bengaluru and Pune offices, and production deploys on holidays require an approved exception【ENG-003】【HR-HOL-2026】.  

(If you obtain a VP Engineering‑approved exception and a holiday‑deployment exception, the deployment could proceed.)

chunks.title: Environments, Deployment Process and Release Management
chunks.text:
## 3. Deployment pipeline
1. Merge to `main` → GitHub Actions builds the image → auto-deploy to **staging** via ArgoCD.
2. Automated integration and smoke tests run on staging (~20 min).
3. Promote to production with `orb release promote <service> --to prod` or the "Promote" button in the Release Dashboard.
4. Production deploys use a **canary**: 5% traffic for 15 minutes → 25% → 100%, with automatic rollback if error rate rises above 1% or p99 latency rises by 30%.

## 4. Deployment windows
- Allowed: **Monday–Thursday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM local time** of the deploying team.
- **No production deploys on Fridays, weekends or public holidays** without an approved exception.
- Freeze windows: see ENG-004 §5.
- Emergency hotfixes during restricted windows require approval from the on-call Engineering Manager **and** be linked to an active incident or Jira P0.

- Paid work for another organisation, including freelancing, is **not permitted** without written approval from your HRBP and department head.

results.question: My VPN is connected but Confluence won't open. What should I try?
results.answer:
Flush your DNS cache (e.g., `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache` on macOS or `ipconfig /flushdns` on Windows) and try switching to a nearer VPN gateway.  
- Use the OS‑specific command for your machine.  
- If the issue persists, raise an OrbitDesk → IT → “VPN issue” ticket with a screenshot and the output of **Help → Collect Logs**. [IT-003]

chunks.title: VPN (Orbitra SecureConnect) – Setup and Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| "Portal not reachable" | Check internet. Try a hotspot. Ensure the portal is vpn.orbitra.io (not vpn.orbitra.com). |
| Stuck at "Connecting…" | Disconnect, quit the app, reopen. On Mac: `sudo killall PanGPS`; on Windows restart the "PanGPS" service. |
| Okta push not received | Open Okta Verify and pull to refresh; check phone time is set to automatic. Use the 6-digit code as fallback. |
| "Authentication failed" | Your password may have expired. Reset at **orbitra.okta.com → Forgot password**, wait 5 minutes, retry. |
| Connected but internal sites don't open | Flush DNS (Mac: `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache`; Windows: `ipconfig /flushdns`). Switch gateway to a nearer one. |
| Slow speed on VPN | Use Auto gateway; avoid running large downloads; video calls do not need VPN (split tunnelling is enabled for Zoom/Slack/Google). |

chunks.title: VPN (Orbitra SecureConnect) – Setup and Troubleshooting
chunks.text: If none of the above works, raise OrbitDesk → IT → "VPN issue" with a screenshot and the output of **Help → Collect Logs**. If you are fully blocked, call Ext. 4000 (treated as P2).

chunks.title: VPN (Orbitra SecureConnect) – Setup and Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
| "HIP check failed" | Your laptop is non-compliant (OS update pending, disk encryption off, or antivirus disabled). Install pending updates and restart. |
| VPN works at home but not at a hotel | Hotel networks may block UDP; SecureConnect will fall back to TCP 443 automatically—wait 60 seconds. If it still fails, use a mobile hotspot. |

## 1. Principles
Spend company money as if it were your own. Expenses must be business-related, reasonable, approved and supported by valid receipts.

## 2. How to claim
1. Submit claims in **SpendWise** (spendwise.orbitra.internal or the mobile app — snap a photo of the receipt).

chunks.text:
## 3. Deployment pipeline
1. Merge to `main` → GitHub Actions builds the image → auto-deploy to **staging** via ArgoCD.
2. Automated integration and smoke tests run on staging (~20 min).
3. Promote to production with `orb release promote <service> --to prod` or the "Promote" button in the Release Dashboard.
4. Production deploys use a **canary**: 5% traffic for 15 minutes → 25% → 100%, with automatic rollback if error rate rises above 1% or p99 latency rises by 30%.

## 4. Deployment windows
- Allowed: **Monday–Thursday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM local time** of the deploying team.
- **No production deploys on Fridays, weekends or public holidays** without an approved exception.
- Freeze windows: see ENG-004 §5.
- Emergency hotfixes during restricted windows require approval from the on-call Engineering Manager **and** be linked to an active incident or Jira P0.

results.question: My Basic is INR 60,000 and HRA is INR 30,000 per month. How much would I pay to buy out 20 days of notice?
results.answer:
You would pay **₹60,000** to buy out 20 days of notice.  

- The buy‑out amount is calculated as (Basic + HRA) ÷ 30 × days short = (60,000 + 30,000) ÷ 30 × 20 = 3,000 × 20 = ₹60,000. 【HR-EXIT-001】  
- Early release is at the manager’s discretion; the buy‑out applies only if you are not released early.  
- Earned leave balance cannot be used to reduce the notice period.  
- The buy‑out amount is recovered from your final settlement (FnF).

You will **never** be penalised for reporting in good faith, even if you made the mistake.

chunks.title: Information Security Policy and Data Classification
chunks.text:
If a document has no label, treat it as **Internal**.

## 2. Handling rules
- **Sharing externally:** use Google Drive with link restricted to named people (no "anyone with the link"), set expiry. Confidential files require an NDA in place (see LEG-001).
- **Customer data** may only be accessed for a valid support ticket, with the customer's consent where required, via the approved support console (never by copying to local machines).

- **Printing** Restricted data is not allowed.
- **Encryption:** all laptops have full-disk encryption; data at rest in production is encrypted with AES-256.

chunks.title: Acceptable Use Policy and Approved Software (including AI tools)
chunks.text:
# Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)

## 1. General
Company devices, networks and accounts are provided for business use. Reasonable personal use (personal email, news, banking) is allowed as long as it does not affect work, security or bandwidth.

## 2. Prohibited
- Installing pirated, cracked or unlicensed software.
- Torrent clients, crypto-mining, or remote access tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) not provided by IT.
- Disabling or tampering with security agents (CrowdStrike Falcon, Intune, Netskope).
- Using **USB mass storage devices** — blocked by default; exceptions require Security approval.
- Auto-forwarding company email to personal accounts.
- Storing company data on personal cloud storage (personal Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud).

chunks.title: Information Security Policy and Data Classification
chunks.text:
# Information Security Policy

Orbitra is **ISO 27001:2022** certified and has a **SOC 2 Type II** report (renewed annually in August). Every employee is responsible for protecting Orbitra and customer information.

## 1. Data classification
| Class | Examples | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| **Public** | Website content, published blogs, public docs | No restrictions |
| **Internal** | Policies, org charts, internal announcements, this knowledge base | Share only with employees/contractors |
| **Confidential** | Financials, roadmaps, contracts, source code, customer names, employee salaries (individual) | Need-to-know; share externally only under NDA; encrypt in transit |
| **Restricted** | Customer production data, personal data (PII), credentials/secrets, payment data, health data, M&A information | Strictly need-to-know; never in email/Slack/AI tools; stored only in approved systems; access logged |

If a document has no label, treat it as **Internal**.

chunks.title: Annual Leave and Absence Policy – United Kingdom
chunks.text:
# Annual Leave and Absence Policy – UK

## Annual leave
- **25 days** annual leave plus the **8 UK bank holidays**.
- One additional day of leave for each completed year of service, up to a maximum of 30 days.
- Leave year: 1 January – 31 December.
- Up to **5 days** may be carried over; carried-over days must be used by **31 March**.
- The office closes between Christmas and New Year; 3 days of annual leave are reserved for this closure.

## Sickness absence
- Notify your manager before 10:00 AM on the first day of absence.
- Self-certify for up to 7 calendar days; a fit note from a GP is required after that.
- Company sick pay: full pay for up to **20 working days** in any rolling 12 months, then Statutory Sick Pay (SSP).

chunks.title: Paid Time Off (PTO) and Leave Policy – United States
chunks.text:
## Parental leave
- **16 weeks fully paid** for birthing parents (includes short-term disability benefit).
- **12 weeks fully paid** for non-birthing parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
- Must be taken within 12 months of the birth/placement; may be split into at most 2 blocks.

## Other leaves
- **FMLA:** up to 12 weeks job-protected unpaid leave for eligible employees (12 months service, 1,250 hours).
- **Bereavement:** 5 days (immediate family), 2 days (extended).
- **Jury duty:** fully paid for up to 10 days.
- **Voting:** up to 2 hours paid.

## How to request
Request PTO in PeopleHub at least 2 weeks in advance for 5+ consecutive days. Contact your HRBP Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@orbitra.io) for leaves of absence.

Note: US employees do not receive Earned Leave, Casual Leave or comp-off — these are India-only leave types.

results.question: I passed my CKA exam and I'm planning to resign in 6 months. Will the company reimburse it and will they recover it?
results.answer:
Yes – the CKA certification fee can be reimbursed, but because you’ll resign within 12 months the reimbursed amount will be clawed back pro‑rata from your final settlement.

- Resigning within 12 months of the reimbursement triggers a pro‑rata recovery of the amount. [LND-001]

## 3. Approved software catalog (Orbitra App Store highlights)
Chrome, Firefox, Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA (licensed), Docker Desktop (licensed), Postman, Figma, Notion (viewer), 1Password (company vault), Loom, Miro.

chunks.title: Information Security Policy and Data Classification
chunks.text:
If a document has no label, treat it as **Internal**.

## 2. Handling rules
- **Sharing externally:** use Google Drive with link restricted to named people (no "anyone with the link"), set expiry. Confidential files require an NDA in place (see LEG-001).
- **Customer data** may only be accessed for a valid support ticket, with the customer's consent where required, via the approved support console (never by copying to local machines).
- **Secrets** (API keys, passwords) must be stored in **HashiCorp Vault** (engineering) or **1Password** (teams). Never in code, Slack or Confluence.
- **Clean desk / clear screen:** lock your screen when away (Win+L / Ctrl+Cmd+Q). Auto-lock after 5 minutes.
- **Printing** Restricted data is not allowed.
- **Encryption:** all laptops have full-disk encryption; data at rest in production is encrypted with AES-256.

chunks.title: Acceptable Use Policy and Approved Software (including AI tools)
chunks.text:
# Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)

## 1. General
Company devices, networks and accounts are provided for business use. Reasonable personal use (personal email, news, banking) is allowed as long as it does not affect work, security or bandwidth.

## 2. Prohibited
- Installing pirated, cracked or unlicensed software.
- Torrent clients, crypto-mining, or remote access tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) not provided by IT.
- Disabling or tampering with security agents (CrowdStrike Falcon, Intune, Netskope).
- Using **USB mass storage devices** — blocked by default; exceptions require Security approval.
- Auto-forwarding company email to personal accounts.
- Storing company data on personal cloud storage (personal Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud).

chunks.title: Information Security Policy and Data Classification
chunks.text:
# Information Security Policy

Orbitra is **ISO 27001:2022** certified and has a **SOC 2 Type II** report (renewed annually in August). Every employee is responsible for protecting Orbitra and customer information.

## 1. Data classification
| Class | Examples | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| **Public** | Website content, published blogs, public docs | No restrictions |
| **Internal** | Policies, org charts, internal announcements, this knowledge base | Share only with employees/contractors |
| **Confidential** | Financials, roadmaps, contracts, source code, customer names, employee salaries (individual) | Need-to-know; share externally only under NDA; encrypt in transit |
| **Restricted** | Customer production data, personal data (PII), credentials/secrets, payment data, health data, M&A information | Strictly need-to-know; never in email/Slack/AI tools; stored only in approved systems; access logged |

If a document has no label, treat it as **Internal**.

Chrome, Firefox, Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA (licensed), Docker Desktop (licensed), Postman, Figma, Notion (viewer), 1Password (company vault), Loom, Miro.

| **OrbitBot** (internal) | Approved | Up to Confidential |

chunks.title: Information Security Policy and Data Classification
chunks.text:
If a document has no label, treat it as **Internal**.

## 2. Handling rules
- **Sharing externally:** use Google Drive with link restricted to named people (no "anyone with the link"), set expiry. Confidential files require an NDA in place (see LEG-001).
- **Customer data** may only be accessed for a valid support ticket, with the customer's consent where required, via the approved support console (never by copying to local machines).
- **Secrets** (API keys, passwords) must be stored in **HashiCorp Vault** (engineering) or **1Password** (teams). Never in code, Slack or Confluence.
- **Clean desk / clear screen:** lock your screen when away (Win+L / Ctrl+Cmd+Q). Auto-lock after 5 minutes.
- **Printing** Restricted data is not allowed.
- **Encryption:** all laptops have full-disk encryption; data at rest in production is encrypted with AES-256.

chunks.title: Acceptable Use Policy and Approved Software (including AI tools)
chunks.text:
# Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)

## 1. General
Company devices, networks and accounts are provided for business use. Reasonable personal use (personal email, news, banking) is allowed as long as it does not affect work, security or bandwidth.

## 2. Prohibited
- Installing pirated, cracked or unlicensed software.
- Torrent clients, crypto-mining, or remote access tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) not provided by IT.
- Disabling or tampering with security agents (CrowdStrike Falcon, Intune, Netskope).
- Using **USB mass storage devices** — blocked by default; exceptions require Security approval.
- Auto-forwarding company email to personal accounts.
- Storing company data on personal cloud storage (personal Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud).

chunks.title: Information Security Policy and Data Classification
chunks.text:
# Information Security Policy

Orbitra is **ISO 27001:2022** certified and has a **SOC 2 Type II** report (renewed annually in August). Every employee is responsible for protecting Orbitra and customer information.

## 1. Data classification
| Class | Examples | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| **Public** | Website content, published blogs, public docs | No restrictions |
| **Internal** | Policies, org charts, internal announcements, this knowledge base | Share only with employees/contractors |
| **Confidential** | Financials, roadmaps, contracts, source code, customer names, employee salaries (individual) | Need-to-know; share externally only under NDA; encrypt in transit |
| **Restricted** | Customer production data, personal data (PII), credentials/secrets, payment data, health data, M&A information | Strictly need-to-know; never in email/Slack/AI tools; stored only in approved systems; access logged |

If a document has no label, treat it as **Internal**.

results.question: My VPN is connected but Confluence won't open. What should I try?
results.answer:
Flush your DNS cache (e.g., `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache` on macOS or `ipconfig /flushdns` on Windows) and try switching to a nearer VPN gateway.  
- Use the OS‑specific command for your machine.  
- If the issue persists, raise an OrbitDesk → IT → “VPN issue” ticket with a screenshot and the output of **Help → Collect Logs**. [IT-003]

# Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)

## 1. General
Company devices, networks and accounts are provided for business use. Reasonable personal use (personal email, news, banking) is allowed as long as it does not affect work, security or bandwidth.

## 2. Prohibited
- Installing pirated, cracked or unlicensed software.

|---|---|---|

If a document has no label, treat it as **Internal**.

results.question: How long does my account stay locked after too many wrong passwords?
results.answer:
Your account is locked for **30 minutes** after too many wrong passwords.  
- Lockout occurs after **5 failed login attempts**.

chunks.title: Accounts, Passwords, MFA and Application Access
chunks.text:
# Accounts, Passwords, MFA and Access

## 1. Single sign-on (Okta)
All company applications are accessed through **orbitra.okta.com**. Your username is your email address.

## 2. Password rules
- Minimum **14 characters**; must not contain your name or "orbitra".
- Passwords expire every **180 days**; you receive reminders 14, 7 and 1 day before expiry.
- Last 10 passwords cannot be reused.
- **Self-service reset:** orbitra.okta.com → "Forgot password?" → verify with Okta Verify or SMS. Takes 2 minutes.
- On Mac, after a reset, the laptop login password syncs on next login while connected to the internet (Okta Platform SSO). If it doesn't sync, connect to the office Wi-Fi or VPN and lock/unlock the screen.

## 3. Account lockout
After **5 failed attempts** your account is locked for **30 minutes** and then unlocks automatically. To unlock immediately, use self-service unlock at orbitra.okta.com or call Ext. 4000.

Yes – the CKA certification fee can be reimbursed, but because you’ll resign within 12 months the reimbursed amount will be clawed back pro‑rata from your final settlement.

- Pre‑approval from your manager must have been recorded in LearnSphere before you booked the exam. [LND-001]  
- You must submit the claim (certificate + invoice) in SpendWise within 60 days of passing. [FIN-001]  
- Resigning within 12 months of the reimbursement triggers a pro‑rata recovery of the amount. [LND-001]
- Exception: your skip-level manager can waive this rule if you email them a short justification, and the waiver applies immediately.

chunks.text:
## 3. Certifications
- **Pre-approval** from the manager is required in LearnSphere → "Certification request" before booking the exam.
- The exam fee is **reimbursed only after passing**, claimed via SpendWise → "Learning & Development" with the certificate and invoice, within 60 days of passing.
- **One retake** is reimbursed if the first attempt fails, provided the retake is passed.
- Priority certifications (reimbursed **outside** the annual budget): AWS Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional), AWS Security Specialty, CKA/CKAD, Google Professional Cloud Architect, CISSP, PMP, Salesforce Administrator (Sales Ops).

## 4. Higher education sponsorship
- Up to **INR 3,00,000 per year** (max 2 years) for part-time degree programmes relevant to the role (e.g., executive MBA, M.Tech).
- Eligibility: 2+ years at Orbitra, rating ≥ 4 in the last cycle, approval by L9 and CHRO.

# Expense Reimbursement Policy

## 1. Principles
Spend company money as if it were your own. Expenses must be business-related, reasonable, approved and supported by valid receipts.

## 2. How to claim
1. Submit claims in **SpendWise** (spendwise.orbitra.internal or the mobile app — snap a photo of the receipt).
2. **Submit within 30 days** of the expense date. Claims older than **60 days** are rejected automatically unless approved by the Financial Controller.
3. Receipts are mandatory for any expense **above INR 500**. Below INR 500, a self-declaration is accepted (max INR 3,000 per month).
4. Approval flow: Manager → Finance audit. Amounts above the manager's authority go to the next level (see COM-002 approval matrix).
5. **Payment:** Claims fully approved by the **20th** are paid with that month's salary. Claims approved after the 20th are paid in the next month's salary. US/UK: paid by bank transfer in the next weekly run (every Friday).

## 5. Clawback
If you resign within **12 months** of reimbursement for a certification or course above INR 25,000 (or within **24 months** for higher education sponsorship), the amount is recovered pro-rata from the Full and Final settlement (see HR-EXIT-001).

## 6. Learning time
Employees can use up to **5 working days per year** as "Learning Days" for structured learning (mark in PeopleHub → Attendance → "Learning Day"), with manager approval.

## 7. Internal programmes
- **LeadStart** (first-time managers, L6–L7) — 8-week cohort, nomination by HRBP, twice a year.
- **Tech Talks** — every Friday 4 PM IST in #tech-talks.
- **Mentorship programme** — apply in April and October on LearnSphere.

## Part B – Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption (ABAC)
Orbitra complies with the Prevention of Corruption Act (India), the US FCPA and the UK Bribery Act 2010.
- Never offer, give, request or accept anything of value to improperly influence a business decision.
- **Facilitation payments** ("speed money") are prohibited, even if small or customary.
- **Government officials** (including employees of state-owned enterprises): no gifts, meals or hospitality without prior written approval from Legal.
- Third-party agents and resellers must undergo ABAC due diligence before onboarding.
- Gifts and hospitality limits are in HR-COC-001 §4.
- Report concerns to ethics@orbitra.io or the Ethics Hotline (LEG-003).

chunks.text:
## 4. Vendor onboarding
Ask Procurement to send the vendor the onboarding link. Vendor must submit: PAN, GST certificate, cancelled cheque, MSME certificate (if applicable), W-9/W-8 (US). Vendors cannot be paid until onboarding is complete.

## 5. Invoices and payment terms
- Vendors email invoices to **invoices@orbitra.io** with the PO number.
- Standard payment terms: **Net 45** days from invoice receipt. MSME vendors (India): **Net 45 maximum by law**, paid within 30 days as Orbitra practice.
- Payment runs: every **Tuesday and Friday**.
- To check payment status, ask the vendor to email ap-queries@orbitra.io with the invoice number, or check NetSuite → Vendor Bills.

## 6. Vendor bank detail changes
Bank changes require: a request on vendor letterhead, a cancelled cheque, and **call-back verification** by AP on the number in the vendor master (never the number in the email). This is mandatory due to frequent fraud attempts (see SEC-002).

chunks.title: Reporting Security Incidents and Phishing
chunks.text:
You will **never** be penalised for reporting in good faith, even if you made the mistake.

## 3. How to spot phishing
- Sender domain looks similar but wrong (orbitra-hr.com, 0rbitra.io). Only **@orbitra.io** is ours.
- Urgency or secrecy: "do this now, don't tell anyone".
- Requests for gift cards, wire transfers, bank detail changes, or OTPs.
- Unexpected attachments (.html, .zip, .iso) or QR codes.
- Executives will **never** ask you to buy gift cards or share OTPs over WhatsApp.

## 4. Vendor bank detail change requests
Any email asking to change a vendor's bank account must be verified by **calling the vendor on a known number** (not the number in the email). Finance must follow FIN-003 §6.

## 5. What happens after you report
Security triages within 30 minutes (24x7). You may be asked to hand over your laptop for forensic analysis; a loaner will be provided.

# Accounts, Passwords, MFA and Access

## 1. Single sign-on (Okta)
All company applications are accessed through **orbitra.okta.com**. Your username is your email address.

## 2. Password rules
- Minimum **14 characters**; must not contain your name or "orbitra".
- Passwords expire every **180 days**; you receive reminders 14, 7 and 1 day before expiry.
- Last 10 passwords cannot be reused.
- **Self-service reset:** orbitra.okta.com → "Forgot password?" → verify with Okta Verify or SMS. Takes 2 minutes.
- On Mac, after a reset, the laptop login password syncs on next login while connected to the internet (Okta Platform SSO). If it doesn't sync, connect to the office Wi-Fi or VPN and lock/unlock the screen.

## 3. Account lockout
After **5 failed attempts** your account is locked for **30 minutes** and then unlocks automatically. To unlock immediately, use self-service unlock at orbitra.okta.com or call Ext. 4000.

chunks.text:
# Accounts, Passwords, MFA and Access

## 1. Single sign-on (Okta)
All company applications are accessed through **orbitra.okta.com**. Your username is your email address.

## 2. Password rules
- Minimum **14 characters**; must not contain your name or "orbitra".
- Passwords expire every **180 days**; you receive reminders 14, 7 and 1 day before expiry.
- Last 10 passwords cannot be reused.
- **Self-service reset:** orbitra.okta.com → "Forgot password?" → verify with Okta Verify or SMS. Takes 2 minutes.
- On Mac, after a reset, the laptop login password syncs on next login while connected to the internet (Okta Platform SSO). If it doesn't sync, connect to the office Wi-Fi or VPN and lock/unlock the screen.

## 3. Account lockout
After **5 failed attempts** your account is locked for **30 minutes** and then unlocks automatically. To unlock immediately, use self-service unlock at orbitra.okta.com or call Ext. 4000.

results.question: My VPN is connected but Confluence won't open. What should I try?
results.answer:
Flush your DNS cache (e.g., `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache` on macOS or `ipconfig /flushdns` on Windows) and try switching to a nearer VPN gateway.  
- Use the OS‑specific command for your machine.  
- If the issue persists, raise an OrbitDesk → IT → “VPN issue” ticket with a screenshot and the output of **Help → Collect Logs**. [IT-003]
- Exception: your skip-level manager can waive this rule if you email them a short justification, and the waiver applies immediately.

chunks.title: VPN (Orbitra SecureConnect) – Setup and Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| "Portal not reachable" | Check internet. Try a hotspot. Ensure the portal is vpn.orbitra.io (not vpn.orbitra.com). |
| Stuck at "Connecting…" | Disconnect, quit the app, reopen. On Mac: `sudo killall PanGPS`; on Windows restart the "PanGPS" service. |
| Okta push not received | Open Okta Verify and pull to refresh; check phone time is set to automatic. Use the 6-digit code as fallback. |
| "Authentication failed" | Your password may have expired. Reset at **orbitra.okta.com → Forgot password**, wait 5 minutes, retry. |
| Connected but internal sites don't open | Flush DNS (Mac: `sudo dscacheutil -flushcache`; Windows: `ipconfig /flushdns`). Switch gateway to a nearer one. |
| Slow speed on VPN | Use Auto gateway; avoid running large downloads; video calls do not need VPN (split tunnelling is enabled for Zoom/Slack/Google). |

chunks.title: VPN (Orbitra SecureConnect) – Setup and Troubleshooting
chunks.text: If none of the above works, raise OrbitDesk → IT → "VPN issue" with a screenshot and the output of **Help → Collect Logs**. If you are fully blocked, call Ext. 4000 (treated as P2).

chunks.title: VPN (Orbitra SecureConnect) – Setup and Troubleshooting
chunks.text:
| "HIP check failed" | Your laptop is non-compliant (OS update pending, disk encryption off, or antivirus disabled). Install pending updates and restart. |
| VPN works at home but not at a hotel | Hotel networks may block UDP; SecureConnect will fall back to TCP 443 automatically—wait 60 seconds. If it still fails, use a mobile hotspot. |

# Expense Reimbursement Policy

## 1. Principles
Spend company money as if it were your own. Expenses must be business-related, reasonable, approved and supported by valid receipts.

## 2. How to claim
1. Submit claims in **SpendWise** (spendwise.orbitra.internal or the mobile app — snap a photo of the receipt).
2. **Submit within 30 days** of the expense date. Claims older than **60 days** are rejected automatically unless approved by the Financial Controller.

5. **Payment:** Claims fully approved by the **20th** are paid with that month's salary. Claims approved after the 20th are paid in the next month's salary. US/UK: paid by bank transfer in the next weekly run (every Friday).
